topNews.text: Critically-Endangered Red Ruffed Lemur Triplets Born at Wild Georgia Theme Park
topNews.excerpt: A Critically-Endangered lemur couple has welcomed triplets into their lives at a zoo and theme park in Valdosta, Georgia. It’s the third year in a row the resident female has given birth at Wild Adventures Theme Park, showing how productive captive breeding programs can be, and how much hope one should have about the future
topNews.creator: Andy Corbley
